description: This header file declares a function ExtractLaunchTemplates within the cuttlefish namespace, which returns a Result wrapping an EnvironmentSpecification and takes a configuration parameter. It includes external dependencies such as result.h and load_config.pb.h.

methods.name: ExtractLaunchTemplates
methods.description: A function that extracts launch templates from a given EnvironmentSpecification configuration, returning a Result with the environment specification.
